current_norm_gate.authority: Полный академический справочник под ред. В. В. Лопатина, §78, пункт 4б
current_norm_gate.model: Current academic rules independently retain fixed constructions with single and repeated НИ, including lexicalized idioms. The dedicated learner issue is recognition of fixed-expression membership and its fixed spelling/punctuation behaviour, not merely the productive generic function of НИ.

reopens.new_evidence_event: Primary Rosenthal §62 is now directly available and explicitly owns the fixed-idiom branch; the source-ownership blocker in file 237 no longer exists.
reopens.policy_compliance: This is a new source-evidence resolution, not restoration merely because current dictionary examples exist.

canonical_units.decision_model: First determine whether the wording is a conventional fixed expression. If it is, preserve its normative fixed НИ pattern instead of rebuilding the phrase mechanically from productive negative-pronoun or homogeneous-member rules.

ownership_boundary.school-ni-particle-vs-repeating-conjunct: owns productive functional distinction of reinforcing НИ vs repeated conjunction НИ…НИ; does not replace memorized fixed-expression membership
ownership_boundary.school-ne-ni-pronominal-exclamatory-vs-c: owns productive НЕ/НИ clause contrast; fixed lexicalized expressions here are not recounted as subordinate-clause rules
ownership_boundary.school-pri-chem-ni-pri-chem-nipochem: retains its dedicated lexical/functional contrast; overlapping surface phrase НИ ПРИ ЧЁМ is not added to this canonical member core
ownership_boundary.school-negative-pronouns-ne-ni-stress-pr: owns productive negative-pronoun spelling; compositional forms such as НИ С ЧЕМ are not used as the core of this fixed-idiom identity

canonical_units.counting_policy: One lexicalized fixed-expression family. Individual idioms are practice members, not separate denominator identities.
